name: femo-plugin
description: FEMO multi-agent orchestration engine (ZCode adapter) - script-driven multi-agent workflows; the main model directs, each actor speaks from its own ZCode window, humans play along via the projection hub.

description_i18n.en: FEMO multi-agent orchestration engine (ZCode adapter): mount .femo scripts and run multi-agent workflows — the main model directs, each actor is its own ZCode window possessing a soul (no subagents), humans join via the projection hub.
description_i18n.zh-CN: FEMO 多智能体编排引擎（ZCode 适配）：挂载 .femo 脚本运行多智能体流程——主模型当导演，每个角色由一个独立 ZCode 窗口附身出演（无子代理），人类经投影中心参与。
